Uma Shankar And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7
January, 2025

Author: Manoj Kumar Gupta
Bench: Manoj Kumar Gupta
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2025:Ahc:2795-Db
Court No. - 21
Case :- Writ - C No. - 39005 of 2024
Petitioner :- Uma Shankar And Another
Respondent :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Petitioner :- Arun Mishra,Vijay Pratap Singh

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.
Hon'ble Anish Kumar Gupta,J.
1.

The instant petition has been filed praying for a direction to the respondents to pay fair compensation to the petitioners in accordance with the provisions of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 and also to provide them copy of the notification, if any, under Section 11 of the said Act.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
2. Case of the petitioners is that they are recorded bhumidhar of Gata No. 556 area 0.1140 hectare and Gata No. 557 area 0.0680 hectare, village Ramaipur (Jhunsi), Tehsil Phoolpur, District Uma Shankar And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another on 7 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/186220441/
1 Prayagraj.
3.

entities.text: Uma Shankar And Another vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The respondent No. 2 carried out marking on the aforesaid land of the petitioners for construction of Ramaipur-Baraipur connecting road under MLA fund.
The said land of the petitioners has never been acquired nor the respondents have offered any compensation to the petitioners.

4. The State-respondents have submitted written instructions through Executive Engineer,
Construction Division-4 (Kumbh Mela), PWD, Prayagraj and Assistant Engineer, Construction Division-4 (Kumbh Mela), PWD, Prayagraj.
In the written instructions, it is admitted that the petitioners are bhumidhar of Araji Nos. 556 and 557.
The stand taken is that a kharanza marg was in existence since before over Araji No. 556.

It is further stated that over Araji No. 557 abutting a talab,
there is a kachcha marg.
The respondents are only constructing a pakka road over the existing kharanza marg.
It is also stated that the mud work was done in the presence of the petitioners without any objection from them.
In respect of Plot No. 557, it is stated that no part of it is getting affected by the proposed road.
5. In nutshell, it is admitted to the respondents that the petitioners are owners of Araji Nos. 556 and 557.

It is also admitted that over Araji No. 556, they are constructing a pakka road and admittedly,
the State is not owner of the said land.
The plea taken by it that a kharanza marg was in existence over the said land and mud work was done with consent of the petitioners is not admitted to the petitioners.

6. In the circumstances aforesaid, we are of the opinion that the rival contentions are required to be examined by the District Level Committee in terms of Government Order dated 12 May 2016 to which counsel for the parties also do not have any objection.

7. Accordingly, we dispose of the instant petition with liberty to the petitioners to make fresh representation along with true attested copy of the instant order before the Collector, Prayagraj and in which event, he will transmit the same to the District Level Committee for being decided in terms of the Government Order dated 12 May 2016 after affording opportunity of leading evidence to the parties.

Order Date :- 7.1.2025 Mukesh Kr.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) (Manoj Kumar Gupta,J.)
